_nota: Iconos del canal (16/11/2026). Carlos eligió «libro_cruz» (Evangelio abierto + cruz latina de luz, acuarela suave como el banner) y pidió que la cruz se entienda también pequeña. Segunda ronda: misma composición y estilo, pero más contraste de tono (cruz clara sobre masa de nubes oscura), cruz más grande y gruesa, menos rayos y fondo pintado hasta el borde.

referencias.rol: Style reference (the channel banner): copy ONLY its watercolor technique, soft palette and light. Do NOT copy its text, its composition or its birds.

The icon the owner chose. Keep its concept, soft watercolor style, colours and composition (open Gospel book at the base, Latin cross rising from its spine, golden rays, rose and blue-violet clouds). Improve ONLY what the new instructions say.

comun: Delicate watercolor app icon, square 1:1, same soft style and pastel palette as the references: wet-on-wet washes, visible cotton-paper texture, pale sky blue, peach, rose, cream and warm gold light; no black outlines, no navy. Paint the sky wash FULL-BLEED to all four edges of the square (no white paper border, no empty margin). Keep the symbol well inside a central circle so a circular crop loses nothing. The icon must still read clearly when shrunk to 32 pixels: strong TONAL contrast (light cross against a clearly darker surrounding), few big shapes, no fine detail. Absolutely no text, no letters, no people, no faces, no watermark.

variantes.contraste: Same composition as the chosen icon, with these changes: (1) the luminous cream-and-gold Latin cross is about 40 percent bigger and thicker, still with the vertical beam clearly LONGER than the crossbar and the lower arm about twice the upper arm, with a thin deep-amber watercolor edge that separates it from the sky; (2) directly behind the cross, the clouds and sky are a clearly DARKER mid-tone dusty violet-blue and rose (like a dusk sky), so the bright cross stands out strongly in tone, with a soft bright glow around it; (3) only 8 to 10 bold, simple golden rays; (4) the open book stays at the base but smaller and simpler (a few big shapes).
variantes.cruz_grande: Same concept, but the Latin cross is the clear hero: it fills about 70 percent of the icon's height, thick and luminous cream-gold with a deep-amber edge, the vertical beam clearly LONGER than the crossbar (lower arm about twice the upper arm), standing on a small simple open book at the very bottom. Behind it a large soft disc of dusky violet-blue and rose watercolor clouds makes a strong tonal contrast with the bright cross, with a few bold golden rays. Very simple, big shapes, readable at 32 pixels.
